note: Sixth review of 1.24.13: 59 P1AM start/stop sketches (kind right or wrong), with questions that state the wiring in different words; w is the reviewer's own reading of the wiring, bench whether the question is the bench's own. Each wrong sketch's line to write was put in and run as real C++ by the reviewer. On the build it was given: the bench failed 2 right sketches (a // inside a string; a bool from a bitmask), and passed 4 wrong ones it could not run; one line to write did not compile (a // comment hid the rest). Replayed by tests/bench_1253.js.
